## Context                             <!-- [MANDATORY] full narrative, no compaction -->

2026-09-10 audit of all fiscal flows (web checkout registered+guest, whatsappCheckout, POS sale,
saved drafts, table close-out, invoice-flow send/accept, invoice-data-requests) found 2 major + 2 minor
defects, all verified against code. POS, drafts, table and send/accept are healthy (idempotent state
machine, post-commit decoupled emission, no fiscal code on table sessions). The defects: web burns DIAN
consecutives on unpaid orders (F-001), whatsappCheckout has no shipping requirement (F-002), web checkout
has no idempotency key (F-003), web invoice failure is warn-only silent (F-004). Human confirmed three
business decisions: number-at-emit (ADR-01), whatsapp charge-time gate with open creation (ADR-02), web
auto-send on payment confirmation (ADR-03). Grandfathered numbered drafts are never rewritten.

## Criticality Justification           <!-- [MANDATORY] quote the explicit user request that invoked this skill -->

User: "audita y dime si encuentras algun error en los flujos de facturacion en orden, POS, orden
guardada, mesa, web, etc... o alguna mejora sugerida" → then "crea un .agents/skills/how-to-critical-plan/SKILL.md para fixear lo encontrado", corrected to "cuando dije que la uses era para que creara un plan de ese tipo con las instrucciones de la skill", then "Ahora el plan de fix de facturacion lo tienes?" — explicit critical-plan request for fiscal flows where a duplicated or gapped consecutive is unrecoverable before DIAN.

## General Objective                   <!-- [MANDATORY] one sentence -->

Fix the four audited fiscal defects without breaking any healthy flow and without touching already-assigned numbers.

## Specific Objectives                 <!-- [MANDATORY] each individually verifiable -->

1. Abandoned web checkouts consume zero DIAN consecutives (F-001 closed by probe evidence).
2. No physical whatsapp order can be charged or invoiced without method+rate, while creation stays open (F-002).
3. Webhook-approved web payments auto-send the invoice best-effort; failures are flagged on the order, never logs-only (F-004).
4. Double web submit yields exactly one order, one draft, one number (F-003).
5. Web, whatsapp, POS, drafts, table, send/accept and credit notes green end-to-end; two clean audit rounds; `cp-lint.sh` exit 0; `pr-code-review` ≥ 80%.

## Non-Goals                           <!-- [MANDATORY] "None." if none -->

- Rewriting or reclaiming already-assigned consecutives; touching accepted documents except via credit-note flow.
- Changing POS `auto_emit` default or table-session behavior (verified healthy).
- New DIAN document types or provider changes.

## Approach Chosen                     <!-- [MANDATORY] full rationale -->

Fix at the narrowest choke point per finding, reusing existing machinery: move number assignment from
`createFromOrder` to the send path (generator + state machine already idempotent); reuse
assign-shipping validation for the whatsapp charge gate; hook webhook approval into `send` best-effort
like POS auto-emit; add `Idempotency-Key` instead of client-side double-submit guards; mirror the POS
`registerFailure` + fiscal-status pattern for web surfacing. Grandfather everything already numbered.
Each step is independently revertible (flag, guard-removal, kill-switch, header-ignore).

## Alternatives Considered             <!-- [MANDATORY] at least 2 rejected, each with reason -->

- Invoice-at-payment instead of number-at-emit: rejected — pending-transfer orders would still sit
  numberless-but-expected, and it splits web/POS numbering paths instead of unifying at send.
- Block whatsapp creation without shipping (web parity): rejected by the human — assisted sales choose
  the method later on the order; the gate belongs at charge time.
- Cron expiring abandoned drafts as the F-001 fix: rejected — reduces but never removes gaps, and
  expiry of money-adjacent rows on a timer is its own risk; kept only as a possible complement.

## Data Integrity Plan                 <!-- [MANDATORY] "No data mutation." if none -->

- **Migrations:** additive only — nullable number-until-send (or equivalent), order fiscal flag, idempotency table + TTL. No backfill of old rows. No `TRUNCATE`/`DROP`/`CASCADE` anywhere.
- **Backfills:** none.
- **Invariants that must hold before and after:** one invoice per order (existing-check); accepted ⇒ immutable; `send()` single transmission per state machine; scoped-by-store on every new query.
- **Snapshot taken:** no — no destructive op planned; prod snapshot required before the release deploy per standing rules.
- **Dry-run dataset:** sandbox tenant with testing DIAN config; abandoned-checkout probe; DIAN-down probe.
